comment: D76 weather cells. Cell types drift with the shared wind and fade over their lifetime. Channels map a cell onto the coverage texture: R wet, G snow, B fog, A cloud (0..1). snow_zones is the operator's rule that snow may form anywhere. D84: mode 'demo' turns random spawning off and schedules one guaranteed rain shower (demo_rain); mode 'random' is D76's behaviour, and every type still spawns through --weather=<type>.
